name: John Deere Waterloo Works - Drivetrain Operations - Waterloo IA

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed John Deere Drivetrain Operations (formerly Drive Train) at 400 Westfield Ave, Waterloo IA. Roster ROOFTOP coords (moved only 53m) landed correctly. Street View confirmed the John Deere Tractor & Engine Museum sign and TechWorks Campus signage on the southern part of the campus; the active production buildings are the large fenced cluster along the Cedar River to the north.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Inferred true, medium confidence. The active production complex is enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence — clearly visible along the north road on multiple Street View headings (2026 imagery). Truck gate is a driveway break in this fence; a barrier arm could not be individually resolved.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth positively identified at a gate pinch-point. A small peaked-roof structure SE of the production building is a utility/maintenance building, not a guard shack. Set false; remoteGs true by rule.
fieldNotes.campus: Mixed-use campus — active Drivetrain Operations production buildings plus the John Deere Tractor & Engine Museum and TechWorks innovation campus on the south side. Significant building demolition visible (cleared foundations across the central/southern parcels).
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~22 dock doors across the production building faces; recessed dock bays visible in Street View along the north road. Approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Fenced production yard holds material storage racks and ~12 trailers; band 10-25, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No single dedicated multi-row trailer-storage lot — yard mixes material racks and trailer staging; set false.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Gate-to-dock approach is short (docks face the perimeter road closely); chosen over drivewayLong, low confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the urban fabric of Waterloo IA — residential neighborhood adjacent to the south, museum and business park on-campus, river and rail corridor — Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus with 5+ distinct building masses (production buildings, museum, TechWorks).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~110 acres bounded by the Cedar River (W), the north perimeter road, and Westfield Ave / the highway corridor (S).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified; left false.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved yard inside the fence ahead of the docks; inferred true, low confidence.
